name: SplitText
description: Split text into chars/words/lines (with masks) and stagger them in. Kinetic titles.
recipe: const s = SplitText.create('.title', { type: 'chars,words', mask: 'chars' }); tl.from(s.chars, { yPercent: 110, duration: .6, ease: 'power4.out', stagger: .03 }, t0)

name: DrawSVGPlugin
description: Draw SVG strokes on (underlines, arrows, circles, signature lines).
recipe: tl.fromTo('.line', { drawSVG: '0%' }, { drawSVG: '100%', duration: .8, ease: 'power2.inOut' }, t0)

name: MorphSVGPlugin
description: Morph one SVG path into another (icon to icon, blob to logo).

name: MotionPathPlugin
description: Move an element along an SVG path (a cursor, a dot, a plane, data travelling between stations).
recipe: tl.to('.dot', { motionPath: { path: '#route', align: '#route', alignOrigin: [.5,.5], autoRotate: true }, duration: 2, ease: 'power1.inOut' }, t0)

name: Flip
description: Animate between two layouts (grid rearrange, card becomes full-screen). For video, capture states in the build step and add Flip.from() to the timeline.
recipe: const st = Flip.getState('.card'); /* change layout */ tl.add(Flip.from(st, { duration: .6, ease: 'power2.inOut' }), t0)

name: ScrambleTextPlugin
description: Decode/scramble text into its final value (terminal, hacker, reveal of a number).
recipe: tl.to('.code', { scrambleText: { text: 'SOLVED', chars: 'upperCase', speed: .4 }, duration: 1 }, t0)

name: TextPlugin
description: Type or replace text content over time.
recipe: tl.to('.msg', { text: 'Fixed and tested.', duration: 1.2, ease: 'none' }, t0)

name: CustomEase
description: Use our measured curves inside GSAP, e.g. the keynote camera bezier.
recipe: CustomEase.create('keynote', '.626,.279,.251,.907'); tl.to('.cam', { scale: .81, rotationY: -10.76, duration: .696, ease: 'keynote' }, t0)

name: Staggers + labels
description: Stagger lists/grids (from center, edges, random with a fixed seed) and place beats with timeline labels.
recipe: tl.addLabel('proof', 6.2).from('.row', { y: 30, opacity: 0, stagger: { each: .08, from: 'start' } }, 'proof')
